observations: Photo 0 shows a black tower-style UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply).
The device features a blue backlit LCD display and a front ventilation grille.
A stylized 'V' logo is visible at the bottom of the front panel, but the brand name is not legible.
The image is a professional stock photo with a pure white background and a 'STABLE POWER' watermark.
The seller's text provides technical input voltage specifications but omits the power capacity.

risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back or side of the unit.
A video showing the UPS powering a load (e.g., a fan or lamp) while disconnected from mains power.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having dead batteries requiring replacement.

risks.risk: Item may not match the stock photo provided.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual unit in its current environment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used unit in poor condition.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification label on the back of the unit showing the VA rating and model.
Photo of the actual item being sold, not a stock image.
Video of the unit powered on and functioning on battery power.
response.reason: The power capacity (VA) is not specified and is the most critical factor for pricing. Furthermore, the use of a stock photo means the actual condition and existence of the item are unverified.
